methodologyNotes: Roster spans current flagship interactive pet cameras (Furbo 360, Petcube Cam, Petcube Bites 2), general-purpose smart-home cams frequently bought for pet-watching (Wyze Cam Pan v3, Ring Indoor Cam 2nd Gen, Google Nest Cam Indoor Wired, Eufy Indoor Cam C220), and legacy/niche treat-cams (Petzi Treat Cam, Skymee Owl Robot, PetChatz HDX, Pawbo Life). Re-verified 2026-08-16 by fetching manufacturer/retailer/press pages live (petcube.com, security.org, pcworld.com, reviewed.com, androidpolice.com, wellbots.com, hepper.com, tiptopdogz.com, amazon.com). Adversarial pass corrected one major spec-mismatch: the Google Nest Cam Indoor Wired was drafted with 2K/152-deg specs that actually belong to the Nest Cam battery/outdoor 2nd gen — the indoor wired model is 1080p / 135-deg, released Nov 2021. field_of_view_deg is each source's single headline number in degrees (manufacturers mix diagonal/horizontal conventions, not unified here). subscription_required reflects whether a paid plan gates core live-view/treat-toss/alert functionality (not optional cloud-history/AI add-ons) — false for every product. priceUsd is USD MSRP or most common current list price; where no published USD price could be confirmed this pass (Skymee Owl Robot, Pawbo Life) it is left null rather than guessed. Specs that no consulted source disclosed are left null (a null beats a guess). Two draft source URLs were dead/wrong and were replaced. accessedAt 2026-08-16.

products.name: Furbo 360° Dog Camera
products.priceNote: MSRP ~$210 (Furbo store compare-at); commonly street-priced ~$184 and discounted to $144-$189 in Furbo/Amazon sales.
products.provenance: Re-verified via Reviewed.com's hands-on review (Oct 2022): 1080p FHD, 132-degree wide-angle lens, 2022 release, street price ~$184 at Amazon. The '360' in the name refers to motorized rotation range, not lens FOV. MSRP ~$210 per Furbo store compare-at. Draft's original source (shopus.furbo.com product page) now returns HTTP 404, so the source was replaced with the working Reviewed.com review URL.

products.name: Petcube Cam
products.priceNote: MSRP on petcube.com; live page observed at $31.99 at access.
products.provenance: Re-verified on petcube.com/cam: 1080p HD, 110-degree wide-angle view, no treat dispenser (that is the Bites line's differentiator), no motorized pan/tilt (body rotates manually only). Petcube Care subscription is optional and not required for core live-view/two-way audio. Live page price observed at $31.99; $34.99 retained as MSRP.

products.name: Petcube Bites 2
products.priceNote: Official MSRP (petcube.com); listed at $169 sale at access.
products.provenance: Re-verified on petcube.com: $249 MSRP (listed at $169 sale at time of access), 160-degree ultra-wide field of view, holds up to 1.5 lb of treats, stationary unit that does not mechanically rotate/pan/tilt. Smart bark/meow alerts sit behind the optional Petcube Care subscription while live view, two-way audio and manual treat toss are free.

products.name: Wyze Cam Pan v3
products.priceNote: Typical retail/list price (Best Buy, Amazon ~$40); Wyze.com direct is ~$34 plus shipping.
products.provenance: Re-verified via Android Police's review (Wyze official tech-specs page kept as corroboration): 1080p with a 120-degree static lens FOV plus 360-degrees horizontal / 180-degrees vertical motorized pan-tilt, color night vision (Starlight Sensor), no treat dispenser. Basic motion/sound alerts work without a Cam Plus subscription (Cam Plus adds AI detection and cloud storage). ~$40 Amazon / ~$34 Wyze-direct.

products.name: Ring Indoor Cam (2nd Gen)
products.priceNote: MSRP, consistent across Ring, Amazon, and Best Buy.
products.provenance: Re-verified via Security.org's review: $59.99, 1080p HD, 115-degrees horizontal field of view, color night vision, wired/fixed-mount design with no pan or tilt. A Ring Protect subscription is required only for recorded video storage and person detection; live view and push motion notifications work without one.

products.name: Google Nest Cam Indoor (Wired)
products.provenance: CORRECTED. Re-verified via Android Police's Google Nest Cam (indoor, wired) review: 1080p (1920x1080), 135-degree diagonal field of view, released November 2021, $99.99 MSRP (often $70-$85 on sale). The draft's '2K (2560x1440)' resolution and '152-degrees' FOV actually describe the Nest Cam (battery/outdoor, 2nd gen) — Google's spec help page lists those exact figures for that model, which is where the draft error originated. Nest Aware ($6/mo) only extends event history beyond a 3-hour rolling window; live view and push alerts are free. Source swapped to the model-specific Android Police review; Google support page retained as corroboration.

products.name: eufy Indoor Cam C220
products.priceNote: MSRP; widely sold at this price on Eufy.com and major retailers.
products.provenance: Re-verified via PCWorld's hands-on review: $34.99, 2K (2560x1440) resolution, 125-degree field of view, 360-degrees horizontal pan / 75-degrees vertical tilt motorized head with onboard AI subject tracking. Cloud plans (from $2.99/mo) are optional since the camera supports local microSD storage up to 128GB.

products.name: Petzi Treat Cam
products.priceNote: Approximate typical retail (~$170); legacy/limited-availability product with no confirmed current official MSRP.
products.provenance: Re-verified via TipTopDogz review: legacy Petzila product, ~$170 typical retail (no confirmed current official MSRP), one-way audio only (owner can talk to the pet but cannot hear back — a differentiator vs every two-way model in this set), functional treat dispenser (with strict treat-size requirements), no recurring subscription. Resolution and field of view were not disclosed and are left null. night_vision changed from true to null: the consulted source does not confirm night vision, so it is left null rather than asserted.

products.name: Skymee Owl Robot
products.priceNote: No published USD price could be confirmed at access (live Amazon listing rendered no price); historical Amazon range roughly $112-$170.
products.provenance: Existence re-confirmed via Amazon listing (ASIN B0CBRLQRSL), titled 'SKYMEE Owl Robot: 1080P Full HD Pet Camera with Treat Dispenser' — confirms 1080p and integrated treat dispenser. It is a wheeled/motorized mobile robot with two-way talk and IR night vision, explicitly 'no monthly fee'. priceUsd changed from 139.88 to null: the live listing rendered no confirmable price this pass and the price fluctuates, so no published USD price could be verified; the unverified BigBangPrice price-tracker corroboration was dropped. Field of view was not disclosed and is left null.

products.name: PetChatz HDX
products.priceNote: Authorized-retailer MSRP; on sale ~$359 at access.
products.provenance: Existence and price re-confirmed via Wellbots (authorized retailer): the product is literally listed as 'PetChatz HDX' at $376.95 (on sale $359). 1080p HD two-way video chat, up to 150-treat dispenser with a treat-level indicator, sound/motion detection, and included PetChatz Network Service (no required recurring fee; DOGTV streaming is a separate optional add-on). Night vision and exact field of view were not disclosed and are left null.

products.name: Pawbo Life
products.priceNote: No reliably verified current MSRP; legacy product, resellers list it roughly $30-$90.
products.provenance: Re-verified via Hepper's review: 720p HD, 130-degree wide-angle field of view, integrated treat dispenser, two-way audio, and explicitly no bark/activity alerting ('will not alert you to a barking dog'). Manual angle adjustment only (no motorized pan/tilt). A reliable current MSRP could not be confirmed (retailer product pages inaccessible), so priceUsd is left null. Night vision was not documented in the source and is also left null.
